image_info.prompt: This is a photo of a Samsung TV screen showing settings. Transcribe VERBATIM every piece of text visible, especially: IP addresses, port numbers, device IDs, MAC addresses, hostnames, remote-access URLs, and menu/button labels. Do not summarize - list the exact strings you can read. Also state which TV setting screen this is.

This is a photo of a screen showing connection/network settings. Transcribe VERBATIM every piece of text visible, especially: IP addresses, port numbers, device IDs, MAC addresses, hostnames, remote-access URLs, and menu/button labels. Do not summarize - list the exact strings you can read. Also state which app or screen this is.
